mapper.insert: insert into chat_sessions (project_id, user_account_id, leader_account_id, status) values (#{projectId}, #{ownerAccountId}, #{leaderAccountId}, 'ACTIVE')
mapper.select: select id, project_id, user_account_id, leader_account_id, status, disabled_at, created_at from chat_sessions where project_id = #{projectId} limit 1
mapper.update: update chat_sessions set status = 'DISABLED', disabled_at = coalesce(disabled_at, current_timestamp) where project_id = #{projectId} and status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: select distinct cs.id, cs.project_id, cs.user_account_id, cs.leader_account_id, cs.status, cs.disabled_at, cs.created_at, p.title as project_title, latest_message.content as latest_message, latest_message.sent_at as latest_message_at, latest_message.sender_account_id as latest_message_sender_account_id from chat_sessions cs inner join projects p on p.id = cs.project_id left join chat_messages latest_message on latest_message.id = ( select cm.id from chat_messages cm where cm.session_id = cs.id order by cm.sent_at desc, cm.id desc limit 1 ) left join project_members pm on pm.project_id = cs.project_id and pm.account_id = #{accountId} and pm.join_status = 'JOINED' where p.owner_account_id = #{accountId} or p.leader_account_id = #{accountId} or pm.id is not null order by coalesce(latest_message.sent_at, cs.created_at) desc

select a.id as account_id, a.username, a.avatar_url, case when a.id = p.leader_account_id and pm.id is not null then 'LEADER_PARTICIPANT' when a.id = p.leader_account_id then 'LEADER' else 'PARTICIPANT' end as member_role, coalesce(pm.represented_count, 0) as represented_count from chat_sessions cs inner join projects p on p.id = cs.project_id inner join accounts a on a.id = p.leader_account_id or exists ( select 1 from project_members member_check where member_check.project_id = p.id and member_check.account_id = a.id and member_check.join_status = 'JOINED' ) left join project_members pm on pm.project_id = p.id and pm.account_id = a.id and pm.join_status = 'JOINED' where cs.id = #{sessionId} order by case when a.id = p.leader_account_id then 0 else 1 end, pm.joined_at asc, a.id asc
